parameters.subscriptionRequest/filterexpression: soap_status eq 1 and soap_action ne null

parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch>
  <entity name="role">
    <attribute name="roleid" />
    <attribute name="parentrootroleid" />
    <link-entity name="systemuserroles" from="roleid" to="roleid" intersect="true">
      <filter><condition attribute="systemuserid" operator="eq" value="@{variables('Actor')}" /></filter>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>

Allowed.inputs: @and(contains(createArray('approve', 'submit', 'reject', 'reassign'), variables('Action')), equals(outputs('Get_approval')?['body/soap_status'], 1), equals(outputs('Get_step_now')?['body/soap_status'], 1), if(equals(variables('Action'), 'reassign'), and(or(outputs('Is_admin'), and(outputs('Is_assigned'), equals(outputs('Snapshot')?['allowReassign'], true))), not(empty(coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/soap_actiontargetid'], ''))), not(equals(toLower(coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/soap_actiontargetid'], '')), outputs('Requester'))), not(equals(toLower(coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/soap_actiontargetid'], '')), toLower(coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/_soap_assignee_value'], ''))))), and(outputs('Is_assigned'), not(equals(variables('Actor'), outputs('Requester'))), if(equals(variables('Action'), 'reject'), not(empty(trim(coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body/soap_actioncomment'], '')))), equals(length(body('Missing_required_fields')), 0)))))

Outcome_after.inputs: @setProperty(setProperty(outputs('Outcome_before'), 'values', union(coalesce(outputs('Outcome_before')?['values'], json('{}')), outputs('Responses'))), 'stages', if(empty(outputs('Responses')), coalesce(outputs('Outcome_before')?['stages'], json('{}')), setProperty(coalesce(outputs('Outcome_before')?['stages'], json('{}')), string(triggerOutputs()?['body/soap_stageorder']), union(coalesce(outputs('Outcome_before')?['stages']?[string(triggerOutputs()?['body/soap_stageorder'])], json('{}')), outputs('Responses')))))

parameters.$filter: _soap_approval_value eq @{outputs('Get_approval')?['body/soap_approvalid']} and soap_stageorder eq @{triggerOutputs()?['body/soap_stageorder']} and soap_status eq 1 and soap_approvalstepid ne @{variables('StepId')}
_soap_approval_value eq @{outputs('Get_approval')?['body/soap_approvalid']} and (soap_status eq 0 or soap_status eq 1) and soap_approvalstepid ne @{variables('StepId')}
